name: Weak In Flesh
overview: Scripture reveals that human weakness in flesh demands reliance on God's Spirit for guidance and strength, as seen in the plea to be led into uprightness (Psalms 143:10). While people often trust their own understanding, God alone discerns the heart's true condition (Proverbs 21:2). Christ calls believers to a life of self-denial and daily commitment, embracing challenges and loving even enemies (Luke 6:27; Luke 9:23). Transformation through the renewing of the mind enables believers to discern and live out God's perfect will (Romans 12:2), and endurance through temptation results in the promised crown of life for those who love the Lord (James 1:12).
